title: Self Introduction Basics
raw_text: This lesson helps beginners introduce themselves using simple sentences. Learners practice saying their name, country, job or study status, and basic personal information. It focuses on am, is, are and common greeting patterns for first meetings.

module_json.objective_en: Introduce yourself with short, correct sentences.
module_json.objective_id: Memperkenalkan diri dengan kalimat pendek yang benar.
module_json.conversation_scenario: Introducing yourself to a new classmate.
practice_steps: Explain model sentences for self introduction.
Guided pronunciation drill of key phrases.
Pair role-play introducing yourself and asking 3 questions.
Reflection: write 5 lines about your identity.

mini_assessment.instruction: Record a 60-second self introduction with name, origin, and role.

title: Family and People Around Me
raw_text: Learners describe family members and people around them with simple adjectives and possession words. The lesson introduces my, your, his, her and basic sentence structures with have and has.

module_json.objective_en: Describe family members with basic vocabulary and possession.
module_json.objective_id: Mendeskripsikan anggota keluarga dengan kosakata dasar dan bentuk kepemilikan.
module_json.conversation_scenario: Talking about your family to a new friend.
practice_steps: Explain family tree vocabulary and model sentences.
Guided matching activity: family member and description.
Role-play: introduce three family members.
Reflection: write who you are closest to and why.

mini_assessment.instruction: Write 6 sentences and present 3 of them about your family.

title: Daily Routines with Simple Present
raw_text: This module introduces simple present for daily habits. Learners build positive, negative, and question forms and use adverbs of frequency to talk about routines.

module_json.objective_en: Talk about your daily routine using simple present accurately.
module_json.objective_id: Membahas rutinitas harian dengan simple present secara akurat.
practice_steps: Explain simple present patterns and common errors.
Guided sentence transformation (positive, negative, question).
Pair interview: ask and answer routine questions.
Reflection: compare your routine today vs weekends.

mini_assessment.instruction: Write 8 routine sentences and present your schedule in 1 minute.
success_criteria: Uses at least 2 adverbs of frequency

title: Time, Days, and Schedules
raw_text: Learners practice telling time, saying days and months, and making simple schedule plans. It uses prepositions of time and short planning conversations.

module_json.objective_en: Tell time and arrange simple plans with correct time expressions.
module_json.objective_id: Menyebutkan waktu dan menyusun rencana sederhana dengan ekspresi waktu yang benar.
module_json.conversation_scenario: Planning a study session with a friend.
practice_steps: Explain time expressions and at/on/in usage.
Guided listening: identify time and day from short dialogues.
Role-play: make and confirm a schedule.
Reflection: write your weekly mini-plan.

mini_assessment.instruction: Create a 3-event weekly schedule and explain it orally.

quiz.question: Which preposition is correct: '___ Monday at 8 PM'?

title: Home, Places, and Directions
raw_text: This lesson trains learners to describe places and give directions in simple English. It introduces there is/there are and common place prepositions for everyday navigation.

module_json.objective_en: Describe places and give simple directions confidently.
module_json.objective_id: Mendeskripsikan tempat dan memberi arah sederhana dengan percaya diri.
module_json.conversation_scenario: Asking and giving directions in a city area.
practice_steps: Explain place vocabulary and direction phrases.
Guided map labeling activity.
Role-play: tourist asks for directions.
Reflection: describe your neighborhood in 5 lines.

mini_assessment.instruction: Give directions from station to hospital using a simple map.

title: Food, Drinks, and Ordering
raw_text: Learners practice food vocabulary and ordering expressions in cafes or restaurants. This module introduces countable and uncountable nouns, some/any, and polite ordering with would like.

module_json.objective_en: Order food politely and use some/any correctly.
module_json.objective_id: Memesan makanan dengan sopan dan menggunakan some/any secara tepat.
practice_steps: Explain ordering expressions and noun categories.
Guided substitution drill for menu items.
Role-play customer and waiter conversation.
Reflection: write your ideal meal order.

mini_assessment.instruction: Perform a 2-minute ordering dialogue including greeting, order, and payment.

title: Shopping and Prices
raw_text: This module covers practical shopping conversations including asking prices, sizes, and product preferences. Learners use this/that/these/those and how much/how many in store interactions.

module_json.objective_en: Ask and respond about prices, sizes, and quantities in shops.
module_json.objective_id: Menanyakan dan merespons harga, ukuran, dan jumlah di toko.
practice_steps: Explain shopping phrases and demonstratives.
Guided Q&A practice on price and quantity.
Role-play: customer asks for size and pays.
Reflection: list 3 things you want to buy and why.

mini_assessment.instruction: Complete and perform a shopping dialogue with 8-10 turns.

quiz.question: Which question is correct for price?

title: Past Experiences (Introduction)
raw_text: Learners begin talking about past events using simple past regular verbs and time markers. The module focuses on short stories about yesterday and last weekend.

module_json.objective_en: Share short past experiences with simple past regular verbs.
module_json.objective_id: Menceritakan pengalaman masa lalu singkat dengan simple past regular verbs.
practice_steps: Explain regular past verb forms and pronunciation.
Guided timeline activity with past markers.
Pair role-play: what did you do yesterday?
Reflection: write a mini weekend diary.

mini_assessment.instruction: Tell a 6-sentence story about your last weekend.
success_criteria: Uses at least 5 regular past verbs

quiz.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: I am visited my friend yesterday.

title: Health and Everyday Problems
raw_text: This lesson helps learners express basic health problems and ask for help politely. It introduces can/can't and basic should/shouldn't for giving simple advice.

module_json.objective_en: Describe simple problems and give basic advice in English.
module_json.objective_id: Mendeskripsikan masalah sederhana dan memberi saran dasar dalam bahasa Inggris.
module_json.conversation_scenario: Visiting a clinic and explaining symptoms.
practice_steps: Explain symptom vocabulary and help expressions.
Guided matching of problem and advice.
Role-play patient and clinic staff.
Reflection: write 3 healthy habits you should do.

mini_assessment.instruction: State one health problem and give two advice sentences.

quiz.question: Choose the best advice sentence:
options: You should to drink more water.

title: Final Communication Project
raw_text: In this capstone module, learners combine beginner skills into practical communication tasks. They perform integrated conversations: introducing themselves, describing routines, asking directions, shopping, and solving simple daily problems.

module_json.objective_en: Integrate beginner grammar and vocabulary in real-life communication tasks.
module_json.objective_id: Mengintegrasikan grammar dan kosakata beginner dalam tugas komunikasi nyata.
module_json.conversation_scenario: Integrated role-play: meet, plan, buy, and solve a problem.
practice_steps: Explain capstone flow and scoring criteria.
Guided rehearsal with cue cards for each scenario.
Role-play in pairs with rotating roles.
Reflection: self-evaluate strengths and next focus.

mini_assessment.instruction: Complete a 4-part role-play and submit a 120-word personal profile text.
success_criteria: Uses target vocabulary from previous modules

quiz.question: What is the best sequence word for the last step?
